title: Ops sprint snaglist — mid Jul 2026
body:
Purpose: quick one-page rollup for mid-sprint unblock triage. Use this during standups (Tues/Thurs) to call out items that need cross-team pairing or escalations.

How to use: add one line per snag, assign an owner (named), add ETA, and a next-step. Keep notes lightweight — this is sticky-note level, not a formal incident.

SUMMARY (top-of-sheet):
- 9 open snags; 3 blocker-ish (SLA/capacity), 4 depend-on-other-team, 2 docs/QA.
- Current snap estimate: 6 engineering-hours to fully resolve high-priority items (quick patch + rollout).

SNAG LIST (id / area / issue / impact / owner / ETA / next-step / notes):
1 | Serving runtime | Prefix cache miss spike observed on model-x at 1000RPS — tail latency increases ~45% | customer-facing latency SLO risk (95p > 350ms) | Ethan Patel | 2026-07-17 | repro with loadgen (bench-ux/bench-ops) + collect profile | Possible KV eviction pattern; need heap profile and cache-hit telemetry. Short-term: reduce batch size for model-x on prod-A.

2 | Dedicated infra | Autoscaler thrash during burst tests (scale-down too aggressive) | intermittent request rejections for scheduled bursts | Sofia Martinez | 2026-07-18 | run controlled 60m burst + watch scale decisions; tweak cooldown | Tentative fix: bump scale-down cooldown to 300s on Dedicated pools flagged "burstable". Impact: +2% cost.

3 | Console/rollouts | Canary rollout not honoring manual-fallback after 1% error window | deployments stayed at 50% despite errors | Priya (platform-eng) | 2026-07-19 | pairing session w/console-eng to trace rollout state machine | Related to PR #1287 (runtime fallback) — need end-to-end repro.

4 | Observability | Embeddings billing slice shows 12% uplift last week vs baseline | finance ask for breakdown | Liam O'Connor | 2026-07-20 | export per-customer/day embedding counts + sample prompts | Note: likely caused by SE pilot (se-pilot-capacity-impact-lite). Quick query added to /data/ops/embeddings-diff.

5 | Private deployments | Customer A reported failure to start agent after KMS rotation | private deploy customer-impacting | Diego Alvarez | 2026-07-17 | collect agent logs + KMS audit trail; propose hotfix | "Notes to self": confirm KMS token refresh codepath.

6 | Docs / QA | Runbook for cold-start troubleshooting incomplete | slows on-call response | Maya Chen | 2026-07-22 | draft missing sections (kv cache, seq-len checks) and request review | TODO: embed checklist snippets for SRE.

7 | Product | Confusing rate-limit error surfaced in SDK v2.1 | developer experience friction | Sarah Liu | 2026-07-18 | reproduce with sample app + link to SDK issue | Might be a multi-tenant header parsing bug.

8 | Solutions eng | Pilot SE requested temporary capacity bump but not validated | cost vs SLA tradeoff | Solutions team | 2026-07-19 | schedule 30m sync to validate expected RPS | If approved, use reserved burst pool; track via quick-budget tag.

9 | Security | Audit log ingestion delay (~10m) for private-deployments region-eu | compliance visibility gap | Anika Bose | 2026-07-20 | investigate ingestion pipeline backlog; escalate to infra | Initial hunch: S3 event backoff storm.

DECISIONS / ACTIONS (recent):
- 2026-07-15: Bumped Dedicated scale-down cooldown to 300s for flagged pools (temporary). Owner: Sofia.
- 2026-07-15: Prioritized prefix cache profiling for model-x — bench session scheduled 07/16. Owner: Ethan.

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS / DISCUSSION TOPICS:
- Is +2% cost on Dedicated pools acceptable short-term to avoid SLA violations? (Finance and customer-success input requested)
- Do we want a persistent "mini-snaglist" view in Console for active cross-team unblocks? (Product asks UX)

MEETING LOGS / PAIRING SESSIONS PLANNED:
- 07/16 10:30am: Serving runtime profiling (Ethan, runtime-eng, SRE) — reproduce steps ready in /tmp/bench-repro-07-16.txt
- 07/17 3:00pm: Private KMS agent debug (Diego, security, customer-success)

QUICK ESTIMATES (one-off analysis):
- If prefix-cache fix reduces tail latency by 30% for model-x, estimated reduction in client error rate ~0.6% and saves ~1.8% of paid credits per-day for the impacted customer cohort. (rough back-of-envelope, will refine after profile).

NOTES TO SELF:
- Keep this doc intentionally lightweight. If a snag becomes long-lived (>2 sprints), move to a dedicated ticket and link here.
- Add a column next time for "risk if unresolved" (Low/Med/High).

LINKS / QUICK REFERENCES:
- Incident runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/incident-runbook
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1287
- Jira: REDW-3421

Last updated by Maya Chen on 2026-07-16 — ping in #ops-snaglist for immediate attention.
